production.note: US model years 2020 to 2024. First: PCNA calls the launch cars "The 2020 911 Carrera S and 4S Cabriolet", "expected to reach U.S. dealers in late summer 2019", and the US spec sheet porsche-2020-carrera-s-us-specs is headed "2020 911 Carrera S". Last: porsche-2025-carrera-s says "Porsche is adding the new Carrera S to the 911 model lineup for the 2025 model year" (the 992.2 successor), and stuttcars-992-carrera-s dates the 992.1 car "2019 - 2024" with the "close of the 992.1 era (2024)". Stuttcars' 2019 start is the European launch year; in the US the first model year was 2020.

body.note: Quote: "Like the recently introduced Coupe models, both the 911 Carrera S and 4S Cabriolet now feature the wider body". The Cabriolet is the open version of the same variant, so it is listed here rather than as its own record.

configuration.note: Spec sheet: engine type "Boxer, twin-turbo", 6 cylinders

displacementL.note: Spec sheet: "Displacement (Liters): 3.0 l". No cc figure is printed in the US spec sheet; the rounded litre figure is used as published.

drivetrain.note: Spec sheet: "Rear-wheel drive". The all-wheel-drive Carrera 4S is a separate car.

transmission.note: Spec sheet: "7-speed manual transmission" and "8-speed dual-clutch PDK". DCT is Porsche PDK, standard at launch; the manual was added during model year 2020 (stuttcars-992-carrera-s: "7-spd manual (MY2020+)").

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maximum power output @ engine speed: 443 hp @ 6500" (same in the manual and PDK columns). Corroborated by porsche-2020-carrera-s-us-specs-pdk and by pcna-2020-carrera-s-cabriolet: "The flat-six turbocharged engines make 443 horsepower in the S models."

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 7-speed manual. Quote: "Curb weight (lbs): 3382 lbs. | 3487 lbs. | 3298 lbs. | 3402 lbs." under the columns "2020 911 Carrera S | 2020 911 Carrera 4S | 2020 911 Carrera S with manual transmission | 2020 911 Carrera 4S with manual transmission". The PDK coupe is 3,382 lb (also in porsche-2020-carrera-s-us-specs-pdk).
